title: school.data.changed (v1)
description: school -> timetable, topic school.data.changed, key school_id. Written to the school outbox in the same transaction as the change of school data (spec §09, §12): the new snapshot_version and what changed. Only identifiers — no class or subject names, no teacher signatures (spec §04). timetable keeps the highest known snapshot_version (a version built on an older one is stale), creates a QR for a created class or teacher, revokes it for an archived class or a deleted teacher, and for a deleted teacher replaces the signature copies in its versions with «Вчитель #N». Changes are applied idempotently per entity, so replaying an old event loses nothing.

snapshot_version.description: The school's snapshot_version after this change; it grows by one per change (spec §04 «Заклад (профіль)»; timetable keeps the last known one in «Стан закладу»).

changes.description: What changed in this transaction; usually one item.

change.description: Pairs school-service sends: profile updated; bells replaced; class, subject and teacher created/updated; class and subject archived; teacher deleted (with teacher_no); curriculum replaced/updated. `id` is set for a single class, subject or teacher and absent for profile, bells and curriculum. Rules: `id` is required for class, subject and teacher; `teacher_no` is required for a deleted teacher and forbidden otherwise (without it timetable could not replace the signature, spec §07 DEL /teachers/{id}).

id.description: class_id, subject_id or teacher_id of the changed entity.

teacher_no.description: Only for a deleted teacher: timetable writes «Вчитель #<teacher_no>» instead of the signature (spec §07, DEL /teachers/{id}).
